title: Hark the Herald Angels Sing
lyrics_original: Peace on earth, and mercy mild,
Join the triumph of the skies;
Late in time, behold Him come,
Veiled in flesh the Godhead see;
Pleased as man with men to dwell,
Hail the heav'nly Prince of Peace!
Light and life to all He brings,
Ris'n with healing in His wings.
Mild He lays His glory by,
Born that man no more may die.
Born to raise the sons of earth,
Born to give them second birth.
Of beauty, Thou art the sum;
Stamp Thine image in its place:
Work in me, restore this hour;

bible_verses.english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people. For there is born to you today, in the city of David, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord. This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.” Suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying, “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be ruler in Israel; whose goings out are from of old, from everlasting.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for coming to earth to reconcile us to God and bring true peace to my soul. As I sing alongside the angels, fill my heart with the awe and wonder of Your humble birth in Bethlehem. May the joy of Your salvation overflow in my life today, drawing others to Your gentle mercy. I give You all glory, my newborn King and Savior. Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: "Hark! The Herald Angels Sing" echoes the cosmic joy of heaven breaking into our world. At the heart of the angels' song is the miraculous truth of reconciliation: God sent His Son to bridge the gap between heaven and humanity, bringing true peace to our weary hearts. As we join our voices with the heavenly host, we are invited to step into the triumphant light of Christ's birth. Let your heart be lifted today as you praise the newborn King who brings mercy, restoration, and endless joy.
